blogPosts.title: The Science of Kshirapak Vidhi: How 21 Himalayan Herbs Reverse Hair Fall
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover the ancient 72-hour slow-boiling ritual that locks active alkaloids from Bhringraj and Amla into a deep-penetrating elixir.
blogPosts.content:
What is Kshirapak Vidhi?

Kshirapak Vidhi is an esteemed Vedic pharmaceutical preparation where medicinal herbs are slow-boiled in pure cow milk and cold-pressed sesame oil until the entire moisture evaporates, leaving behind only the concentrated therapeutic essence of the botanicals.

Why Modern Mineral Oils Fail

Standard commercial hair oils contain up to 90% liquid paraffin (mineral oil), which merely coats the hair shaft in synthetic silicone wax, suffocating the dermal papilla. In contrast, Herbic Cure 21 Herbs Fusion Hair Oil is 100% natural, penetrating all three layers of the hair follicle to stimulate active root cells.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Meera Nambiar (BAMS, MD Ayurveda)

blogPosts.title: Why You Must Switch from Plastic Combs to Pure Neem Wood Immediately
blogPosts.excerpt: How plastic combs generate static charge that tears fragile follicles, and why handcrafted Neem wood acts as a natural scalp doctor.
blogPosts.content:
The Hidden Cause of Brushing Hair Loss: Static Friction

When synthetic plastic or nylon combs pass through dry hair, they generate up to 2,000 volts of static micro-friction. This static pulls brittle root bulbs straight out of their follicles.

The Healing Power of Neem Wood

Herbic Cure Neem Wood Combs are carved from seasoned Margosa (Neem) timber. Each stroke distributes natural scalp lipids evenly along the shaft while depositing trace amounts of azadirachtin to keep dandruff and bacteria away.
blogPosts.author: Ayurvedic Wellness Team
